request.prompt: Scene: the Stables, near view at a player's eye height inside, dusk light through a broken roof. A long stone stable with wooden stalls and rotten hay. In the stalls stand gaunt undead horses, some rotting green-grey zombie horses and some bone-white skeleton horses, one wearing dented iron barding, standing still. Between them, undead grooms in rags with iron-tipped spears rise and turn toward the viewer. At the far end a wide doorway opens onto the grey courtyard.
request.style_note: Vesperhold, a half-ruined Gothic castle standing on a rock crag in the middle of a wide mountain bowl, drawn in the same hand throughout: dark-fantasy concept painting, muted slate-grey, ash and moss-green palette with small warm accents of candle and fire light, soft rain haze, confident painterly brushwork with crisp readable architectural silhouettes, massing built from large squared stone blocks with flat faces and clean right angles so every form could be built block by block. Each image is ONE single full-frame view of that place, filling the frame edge to edge: never a sheet, never a grid, never a panel, never an inset, never a caption, label, text or border.
